source.title: feat: enrich Halal Check section with always-visible tier ladder and criteria explanation
source.body:
## User story

As a user of uflow, I need to understand by which halal criteria uflow reviews food places, so I know if it aligns with my definition of halal.

## Problem

The current \"How do we check?\" collapsible in `ProofTierCard` shows only one generic sentence. Users cannot understand:
- What criteria uflow actually checks
- What Bronze/Silver/Gold mean in concrete terms
- What a place would need to reach a higher tier
- That meat halal sourcing verification is coming

## Design decisions (grilled, settled)

| Decision | Answer |
|---|---|
| Methodology source | uflow's own process only — no external certifying bodies |
| Tier breakdown | All three tiers shown as a progressive stepper (Bronze → Silver → Gold) |
| Audience | Both consumers and owners — one unified explanation, consumer-first tone |
| "How do we check?" | Static heading — remove toggle entirely |
| Active tier | Highlighted in the stepper |
| Layout | Progressive vertical stepper — mobile-first |
| Design system | Existing uflow classes |

## Criteria per tier

- **Bronze** — menu reviewed online + no pork/alcohol/gambling confirmed online
- **Silver** — Bronze + on-site visit by uflow team
- **Gold** — Silver (or online) + physical halal certificate on file
- **Coming soon** — halal slaughter standards (general language; uflow is working with suppliers to verify — no bolt-stunning specifics)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] "How do we check?" is a static heading, no collapsible toggle
- [ ] A progressive stepper shows Bronze → Silver → Gold, each step listing what's verified at that level and what's *added* vs the previous
- [ ] The current tier of the shown place is visually highlighted in the stepper
- [ ] A clearly greyed-out "coming soon" row for halal slaughter standards appears below the stepper (not checked off as current)
- [ ] Only criteria uflow actually checks today are shown as active (no_pork, no_alcohol, no_gambling, menu_reviewed, onsite_visit, certificate)
- [ ] All 6 locale files updated with new i18n keys (en, de, ar, tr, ur, ps)
- [ ] Mobile and desktop layouts correct — stepper is mobile-first
- [ ] Uses existing uflow design system classes throughout

## Files to touch

- `src/features/providers/components/ProofTierCard.tsx`
- `src/translations/en.ts` (+ de, ar, tr, ur, ps)
